name: krita-mcp
description: Deterministic Krita execution tools for Claude - paint, draw, animate, and inspect layers in Krita
long_description: Bridge between Claude and Krita painting application. Exposes deterministic painting tools over MCP, allowing Claude to create canvases, paint strokes, draw shapes, manage animation keyframes, inspect layers, query canvas metadata, and export images. Requires Krita to be running with the Krita MCP Bridge plugin installed. This extension provides the execution layer only - Claude provides the intelligence.

krita_url.description: HTTP URL where Krita MCP Bridge plugin is listening (default: http://localhost:5678)
